Hi Samantha / Ben —

Thanks again for the call this morning — good alignment on goals. Per our discussion, I wanted to send a short recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the POC timeline and owners.

High-level success criteria (from your team):
- Improve query latency for patient-record lookups from avg 300ms to <150ms for 95th pct
- Reduce embedding-based search cost by ~30% vs current vendor over 30-day trial
- Integrate with your QA environment (no PHI) and run 3 representative flows end-to-end

Evaluation plan / timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): confirm infra contacts, data access plan, and procurement PO if required
- Week 1: sandbox deployment + sample data ingestion (Redwood dedicated trial instance)
- Week 2: run baseline tests and initial perf tuning (batching / quantization profile)
- Week 3: evaluation with product team, collect qualitative feedback and metrics
- Week 4: wrap + decision / next steps

Proposed RACI (first pass) — please confirm who owns which on your side:
- Redwood (Account/Delivery): Marissa Cole (A) — sales lead, onboarding coord
- Redwood (Technical): Aditya Rao (R) — POC technical lead, deploy + tuning
- Redwood (Customer Success): Lauren Bishop (C) — user feedback, acceptance criteria
- Montgomery Health (App/Product): Samantha Lee (R) — defines acceptance scenarios
- Montgomery Health (Infrastructure): Raj Patel (A/R) — VPC/network, firewall exceptions
- Montgomery Health (Procurement): Ben Turner (A) — PO and contract sign-off

Open items for your confirmation:
1) Confirm the Montgomery folks who will be hands-on for infra and security (we need the names + emails for access requests).
2) Confirm whether test data will be provided in the QA environment or if we should synthesize sanitized samples.
3) Any special compliance constraints (data retention, logging) we should configure for the trial?

Attachments: POC-success-criteria.xlsx, mutual-action-plan.docx, and I attached our Redwood POC playbook (PDF) for reference.

If this looks good I can send a short mutual action plan doc with dates and meeting invites — propose kickoff Wednesday 21 Apr at 10am PT.
